collection.title: BMW X3 2018 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW X3 2018 - 2024 requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Notched Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this BMW X3 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
